summary: AXIA Energia S.A., a Brazilian electric utility, filed a Form 6-K reporting the denial of an appeal by ABRADIN in a long-running civil action. The lawsuit alleged investor losses from privatization and restructuring, specifically that Itaipu Binacional and Eletronuclear were transferred without fair compensation. On April 8, 2026, the TRF-2 unanimously denied the appeal, upholding dismissal of the case. No deal terms, price, premium, or strategic transaction is involved. This is a routine legal update, not a special situation.
